dataset.filter: transcripts with both an assigned 5'UTR and 3'UTR sequence
dataset.target_classification: Low/Mid/High TE tertile-like category, quantile boundaries [0, 0.25, 0.75, 1] on TE3

model1_regulatory_only.description: Regulatory-features-only Random Forest classifier (Low/Mid/High TE). No sequence k-mer features.
model1_regulatory_only.preprocessing_note: SimpleImputer(median) used in place of the original notebook's KNNImputer: verified NaN rate ~0.7%, so results are practically identical, and KNNImputer must retain the full training matrix to find neighbors at predict time (impractical file size for a small NaN rate).
model1_regulatory_only.cv_note: Single canonical split reported (split 0); not independently re-verified across all 10 splits this pass.

model2_xgb_te_regressor.description: XGBoost regressor predicting continuous TE3 from combined regulatory + k-mer (both UTRs) features.
model2_xgb_te_regressor.preprocessing: StandardScaler(X) -> Kruskal-Wallis feature selection (p<0.05) -> asymmetric y outlier trim (train_mean-1*std, train_mean+3*std) -> StandardScaler(y)
model2_xgb_te_regressor.outlier_trim: keep (train_mean - 1*std, train_mean + 3*std) on raw y, using train stats for both train and test
model2_xgb_te_regressor.utr_scope: 5'UTR-only (3'UTR-pattern columns dropped from both regulatory numerics and k-mer matrix)
model2_xgb_te_regressor.reproduction_note: Reproduced r=0.667 vs. paper's 0.694 on the identified split (split 8). Confirmed deterministic w.r.t. XGBoost random_state (30-seed sweep gave identical results); residual gap attributed to package-version differences between this environment and the original interactive session (Python 3.9/current sklearn+xgboost here vs. a base Python 3.12 conda env originally) rather than a methodological error - train-set correlation matches the original almost exactly (0.9926 vs 0.99273).

model3_kmer_classifier.description: Pure k-mer (5'+3'UTR hexamer, 6 windows) Random Forest classifier. No regulatory numeric features.
model3_kmer_classifier.preprocessing_note: SimpleImputer(median) in place of KNNImputer - verified 0% NaN in this feature set, so this is a complete no-op change.

model4_bimodal_classifier.description: Bi-modal Random Forest classifier: regulatory numeric features + k-mer (5'+3'UTR, 6 windows) features combined.
model4_bimodal_classifier.retrained_fresh_note: Retrained fresh under the current environment rather than restoring the original pickle, which requires sklearn 1.2.2 (incompatible with this repo's pinned 1.5.1).

model5_fig6_combo_classifier.description: Random Forest classifier on 3-way multiplicative combinations of top-ranked 5'/3'UTR k-mers, used to rank Figure 6's motif-combination importances.
model5_fig6_combo_classifier.feature_count: n_features_in_ (varies by split, see split-specific selected-triple-features file)

split.note: Split 1 verified by tracing the source notebook's kernel execution order (exec_count), NOT split 0 or split 8, which were considered and ruled out during this analysis.

model5_fig6_combo_classifier.cv_note: Independent held-out CV reconstruction attempted and found NOT reliable: this model's 3-way multiplicative combination features are extremely sparse (a single test-set reconstruction attempt found ~7 nonzero cells out of ~7.6 million), so any small mismatch in the (partially externally-dependent, not fully recoverable) top-motif-pool selection or scaling pipeline collapses predictions to the majority class. Performance is reported as originally described in the manuscript (Figure 6 legend/Methods), not independently re-verified via held-out CV in this pass. See model5_cv_performance.csv for the attempted (unreliable) reconstruction, kept for transparency, not for citation.

cv_attempted_but_unreliable.note: collapsed to majority-class prediction in every split - do not cite

model5_fig6_combo_classifier.prediction_on_new_data_caveat: This model cannot be straightforwardly applied to new sequences without reconstructing the exact top-motif pool used to build its 3-way combination features, which depended on external files not included in this repository. Provided for interpretability/reproducibility of the reported Figure 6 combination rankings, not for out-of-the-box prediction.
